component.name: Dolphy
component.summary: GTK4 file manager inspired by KDE Dolphin

description.p: Dolphy is a GTK4 file manager that reproduces the structure and workflow of KDE Dolphin while staying native to the GNOME/GTK stack.
The current release provides breadcrumb navigation, a Dolphin-style sidebar, a three-column file view and a context menu for files and folders.
High-fidelity Dolphin-style layout with a GTK4 ColumnView.
